title: The Devil Wears Prada 2 Is a Huge Hit—Will We Get a Third Movie?
summary: After waiting 20 years, fans finally got to see The Devil Wears Prada 2—and they showed up in droves! The movie earned a whopping $233 million in its first weekend around the world. That's more than double what it cost to make! In just two weeks, it's already made $435 million and is still going strong. That's more than many superhero movies lately. So, will Disney make a third movie? It seems like a no-brainer. The sequel got great reviews and made tons of money. But there's a catch. The stars—Anne Hathaway, Meryl Streep, Stanley Tucci, and Emily Blunt—were each paid $12.5 million, plus bonuses. A third movie could cost even more. Also, sequels sometimes lose steam. Look at Jurassic World: each new movie made less money. Or Avatar: the third one earned way less than the second. If The Devil Wears Prada 3 came out soon, would fans be as excited? Maybe, maybe not. But with numbers this good, Disney will definitely try. For now, you can catch the fabulous fashion and drama in theaters!
why_it_matters: When you love a movie series, its sequels are made based on whether enough people go to see them — so your ticket choice could help decide if another film gets made.

keywords.explanation: Sequels are follow-up movies that continue the story of an earlier film.
If something 'loses steam,' it means it becomes less popular or successful over time.
Bonuses are extra money paid on top of an actor's regular salary, often if a movie does really well.
Whopping is a word used to describe a very large amount, like a huge sum of money.
Anne Hathaway is a famous actress known for The Princess Diaries and playing Andy in The Devil Wears Prada.
Meryl Streep is a legendary actress who has won many awards and plays the powerful boss Miranda Priestly in the films.

perspectives.description: Disney sees huge profits and excited fans, making a third movie seem like an obvious money-making choice.
History shows many sequels earn less money over time, and paying stars even more could eat into profits.
While many are thrilled to revisit beloved characters, some worry a third film might not capture the same magic.
